scope: AVIS decode failure fix; local validation record. Final immutable-head CI and remote SHA are recorded in PR #1.

root_causes.cause: Sub-8x8 subsampled chroma palette dimensions omitted the normative +2 expansion of both block and on-screen extent.
root_causes.fix: Expand each subsampled dimension smaller than 4 before wavefront palette decoding.

root_causes.cause: A compound neighbor with no coded compound_idx was retained as None, later interpreted as 0 rather than the inferred 1.
root_causes.fix: Initialize compound_idx to 1 for compound blocks, including masked-compound and skip-mode paths.

root_causes.cause: EntropyDecoder rejected every one-byte tile, although arithmetic initialization permits implicit zero padding.
root_causes.fix: Reject empty payloads; accept one byte while preserving the -14-bit exit budget and all trailing-bit checks.

baseline_reproduction.result: Failed: AV1 entropy trailing one bit is missing, first Key frame.
baseline_reproduction.successive_failures: After the palette fix, sample 1 unit 1 failed compound entropy; after inferred-index repair, a valid one-byte tile failed at coded unit 17.
baseline_reproduction.lossless_key_result: Baseline rejected the bundled lossless key with entropy padding overread; fixed decoder matches all 6144 reference samples exactly.

independent_reference.entropy_trace_method: Temporary test-only Rust symbol/boolean logging and a CONFIG_ACCOUNTING reference aomdec build; compare per-operation decoded value, normalized range, difference register and CDF before update. All 61 unit lengths and all 81172 operations match. Temporary logging is not included in production sources.

remaining_limitations: The lossy 60-frame sequence is decodable but not pixel-exact to dav1d/libaom: max absolute native error 228, mean absolute error 3.6842339409722222 over 368640 samples. This is separate reconstruction work, not resolved by syntax/entropy fixes.

The existing bounded StrictAvifSequenceDecoder rejects this multi-coded-frame sample layout (requires exactly one AV1 coded frame). Legacy batch/indexed/incremental APIs are covered by this regression.
